thread.title: Intel, Micron selloffs are overblown, says Mizuho

title: Intel, Micron selloffs are overblown, says Mizuho

organizations.name: emily bary  shares of apple inc

text:
1:42 p.m. ET Share 
By Emily Bary 
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.75% suppliers are down in Thursday trading, as is the chip sector more broadly, after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. TSM, -6.38% trimmed its June-quarter guidance. Mizuho analyst Vijay Rakesh issued a note to clients Thursday afternoon entitled "Buy the Semis with the Least Apple Exposure," in which he recommended automotive names as well as Intel Corp. INTC, -3.19% and Micron Technology Inc. MU, -5.18% "We believe with some of the semi names down 6% today with zero or <5% exposure to Apple, we would be buyers on ON Semiconductor Corp. ON, -6.85% Autoliv Inc. ALV, -1.16% and Cypress Semiconductor Corp. CY, -4.34% as Automotive continues to trend well," he wrote. "We remain buyers of Intel and Micron as data center continues to trend well and Apple is less than 10% of revenue." Rakesh said that pricing for DRAM and NAND are up "despite the much more pronounced demand weakness." The PHLX Semiconductor Index is down 4.4% in Thursday's session, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.86% is down 0.9%. Quote References
